title: Executive Operation -GND
jobDescription: Job Title. Operations SR Executive. Function. Ground Operations. Reporting to. Head - Ground Hub Operations. 1. Purpose. Responsible for all inbound, outbound and transit operations at the Ground Hub during the shift; Ensure timely and accurate connections of shipments onto the ground network during the shift. 2. Key Responsibilities. Responsibilities. Operational. Supervise the entire shift operations in terms of inbound, outbound and transit operations for shipments mainly in terms of tally, documentation and loading operations for. o Ensuring timely and accurate connections of shipments onto the approved ground network. o Ensuring the timely and accurate dispatch of inbound loads to the respective service centers/ PUDs/ DCs/ directly to customers during the shift. Ensure on time arrival and departures of all loads during the shift; Coordinate with origin to provide information on load arrivals and ensure timely further connections of shipments to destination as per scheduled runs. Ensure smooth conduct of activities related to Point to Point operations, Multi-level billing operations and EDL/ ODA operations during the shift. Manage connections of daily inbound and outbound shipments on the rail network. In case of Rail operations, ensure timely load connections and receipt of loads to and from the railway stations. Ensure appropriate and accurate completion of paperwork and documentation for necessary regulatory clearances (octroi, sales tax, etc.) for all inbound, outbound and transit loads during the shift. Coordinate with check-posts and nakas for clearance of shipments. Oversee the work of supervisors in the shift to ensure adherence to the operational workflows, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) at the ground hub. Coordinate and manage all cases of network changes, priority runs, misconnections, etc. occurring during the shift; Provide communication regarding the same to the concerned PUD Centers / Service Centers. Ensure code updations for misconnections, misroutes, wrong tagging, or any such issues and ensure mail communication to the required locations regarding the same. Handle all exception cases during the shift; On a daily basis check on the exceptions of the previous shifts and ensure follow up for closure/ resolution of the same. Ensure availability of sufficient vehicles during the shift for inbound / outbound operations. Provide inputs for fleet requirements and ensure availability of sufficient vehicles for network and feeder runs. Oversee vehicle placement at bays and monitor the tally and loading operations during the shift. Undertake SLAH (stock lying at hub) checking for the shift and take appropriate action for the same. Handle all internal/ external communications during the shift for smooth operations. Check and revert on mails from management, in conjunction with relevant departments. Check attendance and leave data for all staff in the shift; Plan daily operations within the shift as per the loads and attendance. Conduct daily staff briefings, including communication regarding any operational changes in the shift. Support the Head – Ground Hub in shift planning. Ensure safe handling of all shipments and report any damage cases to the origin. Ensure adequate manning of the Ground Hub during the shift in terms of full-time employees, PDAs, loaders, etc. Monitor performance of staff during the shift and support in conduct of regular trainings for regular staff, PDAs, loaders, etc. in line with the training programmes designed centrally. Responsible for generation of all MIS related to Ground Hub operations during the shift. People. Provide direction, guidance and support to the employees to help them discharge their duties effectively. Ensure capability building for the team. 3. Key Result Areas and Key Performance Indicators. S. No. Key Result Areas. Key Performance Indicators. Ensure service quality and excellence in the Ground Hub. Timely connectivity of inbound loads to the PUD / DCs (% compliance). % Stock lying at hub (SLAH). Timely updation of status (in scan, out scan, exceptions, pre-alerts etc) in the system (% compliance within TAT). Adherence to SOPs (measured in terms of number of non-compliances/ deviations) as observed in audit. Number of instances of misroutes and misconnections. Ensure Network Health in the shift. Adherence to network timelines ( number of instances of delays in departure schedules of network vehicles) in the shift. % connectivity of shipments picked up within the cutoff times to the scheduled network runs in the shift. Ensure Performance Driven Culture. Adherence to Performance Management system timelines and guidelines.

The Manager – Finance (Account) is responsible for overseeing and strengthening the organization’s Receivables and Billing operations at the Head Office. The role ensures accuracy, timeliness, completeness, compliance, and system integrity across domestic, international, and Trinity shipment billing processes. The incumbent will drive reconciliation discipline, enhance billing controls, improve automation, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless revenue realization and financial governance. Job Purpose. To ensure robust receivable management and billing governance by maintaining clean ageing, accurate invoicing, international cost-revenue reconciliation, GST and regulatory compliance, strong internal financial controls (ICF), and continuous system-driven process improvements while supporting revenue assurance and operational efficiency. Key Roles & Responsibilities. Receivable Management & Collections Governance . Follow up with Intercompany entities and Third Parties for collections and maintain continuous tracking of outstanding receivables. Reconcile Intercompany ledgers and ensure clean ageing and timely settlement of balances. Monitor Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and initiate corrective actions to keep receivables within target thresholds. Support resolution of disputed invoices in coordination with stakeholders within defined turnaround timelines. Billing Operations & End-to-End Process Oversight . Oversee end-to-end billing for Domestic, International, and Trinity shipments. Ensure accurate processing of agreed international shipment rates in the system master and validate correct cost and revenue billing. Validate freight charges, value-added services, surcharges, discounts, and special contractual rates prior to invoicing. Maintain accurate customer billing profiles and master data in alignment with contractual terms. Monitor billing cycles and update customer master data as per contractual amendments. Ensure invoices comply with contractual terms, GST regulations, and statutory requirements. International Cost Reconciliation & Revenue Assurance . Perform international shipment cost reconciliation with revenue to ensure margin accuracy. Identify revenue leakage risks and collaborate with the revenue assurance team to provide insights and corrective recommendations. Review international inbound and outbound duty taxes billing, payables, and receivables to ensure accuracy and compliance. System Controls, Automation & Interface Reconciliation . Ensure accurate reconciliation of billing data interfaces with financial systems and resolve identified gaps on a timely basis. Liaise with the System Development team to address and close billing-related system issues. Drive automation initiatives in billing processes to reduce manual intervention and eliminate recurring errors. Support system enhancements and master data governance improvements for billing accuracy. Financial Reporting & Provisions . Prepare monthly provision working files for billing and receivables. Prepare Billing and Receivable MIS for various stakeholders including Finance leadership and business teams. Support year-end rate revision activities and ensure timely implementation of updated commercial terms. Compliance, Audit & Governance . Ensure Internal Financial Control (ICF) compliance for Billing and Receivables processes. Coordinate with internal and external auditors for IFC, statutory, and tax audits. Maintain audit-ready documentation for billing, receivables, and reconciliation processes. Work closely with Sales, Pricing, and Operations teams for pricing validation and contract compliance governance. Qualifications & Experience. Education. B. Com Graduate or Post-Graduate in Finance / Accounting. Additional certification in Accounting, Taxation, or ERP systems will be an advantage. Experience. 5 – 7 years of experience in Receivables, Billing, and Finance operations. Experience aligned with RCS Grade L (Indicative Experience Range: 5 – 7 years). Strong exposure to ERP systems such as SAP or Navision. Preferred knowledge of logistics industry receivable and billing components, including freight billing structures and value-added services. Skills & Capabilities. Technical Skills. Strong knowledge of billing systems, ERP platforms, and financial interfaces. Sound understanding of GST compliance and revenue recognition principles. Expertise in reconciliation, ageing analysis, and DSO management. Analytical skills to identify revenue leakages and process inefficiencies. Proficiency in MIS reporting and financial data interpretation. Key Competencies. Attention to Detail & Accuracy . Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving . Cross-functional Collaboration . Accountability & Ownership . Continuous Improvement Mindset . Key Performance Indicators. KRAs . KPIs . Receivable Management . DSO maintained within defined target levels; ageing monitored and improved month-on-month . Billing Accuracy . ≥ 99% billing accuracy across Domestic, International & Trinity shipments . Month-End Closure . Timely completion of month-end billing and receivable processes within defined timelines . International Cost Reconciliation . 100% reconciliation of international shipment cost with revenue; minimal unreconciled variances . Dispute Resolution . Customer disputes resolved within ≤ 2 business days . Process Efficiency . Reduction in manual interventions and recurring billing errors through automation initiatives . Compliance & Audit . Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments. To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments. Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations. Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance. Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes. The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity. Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments. Job Purpose. To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments. Key Roles & Responsibilities. Hub Operations Management. Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement. Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements. Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower. Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives. Mid Mile Network Operations. Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network. Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity. Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy. Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times. Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements. Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards. Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements. Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation. Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency. Service Quality & Operational Excellence. Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency. Safety, Security & Compliance. title: Executive - RSP Operations - HSS
jobDescription: Operations Executive. Job Title. Function. Ground Operations. Reporting to. Head - Ground Hub Operations. 1. Purpose. Responsible for all inbound, outbound and transit operations at the Ground Hub during the shift; Ensure timely and accurate connections of shipments onto the ground network during the shift. 2. Key Responsibilities. Responsibilities. Operational. Supervise the entire shift operations in terms of inbound, outbound and transit operations for shipments mainly in terms of tally, documentation and loading operations for. o Ensuring timely and accurate connections of shipments onto the approved ground network. o Ensuring the timely and accurate dispatch of inbound loads to the respective service centers/ PUDs/ DCs/ directly to customers during the shift. Ensure on time arrival and departures of all loads during the shift; Coordinate with origin to provide information on load arrivals and ensure timely further connections of shipments to destination as per scheduled runs. Ensure smooth conduct of activities related to Point to Point operations, Multi-level billing operations and EDL/ ODA operations during the shift. Manage connections of daily inbound and outbound shipments on the rail network. In case of Rail operations, ensure timely load connections and receipt of loads to and from the railway stations. Ensure appropriate and accurate completion of paperwork and documentation for necessary regulatory clearances (octroi, sales tax, etc.) for all inbound, outbound and transit loads during the shift. Coordinate with check-posts and nakas for clearance of shipments. Oversee the work of supervisors in the shift to ensure adherence to the operational workflows, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) at the ground hub. Coordinate and manage all cases of network changes, priority runs, misconnections, etc. occurring during the shift; Provide communication regarding the same to the concerned PUD Centers / Service Centers. Ensure code updations for misconnections, misroutes, wrong tagging, or any such issues and ensure mail communication to the required locations regarding the same. Handle all exception cases during the shift; On a daily basis check on the exceptions of the previous shifts and ensure follow up for closure/ resolution of the same. Ensure availability of sufficient vehicles during the shift for inbound / outbound operations. Provide inputs for fleet requirements and ensure availability of sufficient vehicles for network and feeder runs. Oversee vehicle placement at bays and monitor the tally and loading operations during the shift. Undertake SLAH (stock lying at hub) checking for the shift and take appropriate action for the same. Handle all internal/ external communications during the shift for smooth operations. Check and revert on mails from management, in conjunction with relevant departments. Check attendance and leave data for all staff in the shift; Plan daily operations within the shift as per the loads and attendance. Conduct daily staff briefings, including communication regarding any operational changes in the shift. Support the Head – Ground Hub in shift planning. Ensure safe handling of all shipments and report any damage cases to the origin. Ensure adequate manning of the Ground Hub during the shift in terms of full-time employees, PDAs, loaders, etc. Monitor performance of staff during the shift and support in conduct of regular trainings for regular staff, PDAs, loaders, etc. in line with the training programmes designed centrally. Responsible for generation of all MIS related to Ground Hub operations during the shift. People. Provide direction, guidance and support to the employees to help them discharge their duties effectively. Ensure capability building for the team. 3. Key Result Areas and Key Performance Indicators. S. No. Key Result Areas. Key Performance Indicators. Ensure service quality and excellence in the Ground Hub. Timely connectivity of inbound loads to the PUD / DCs (% compliance). % Stock lying at hub (SLAH). Timely updation of status (in scan, out scan, exceptions, pre-alerts etc) in the system (% compliance within TAT). Adherence to SOPs (measured in terms of number of non-compliances/ deviations) as observed in audit. Number of instances of misroutes and misconnections. Ensure Network Health in the shift. Adherence to network timelines ( number of instances of delays in departure schedules of network vehicles) in the shift. % connectivity of shipments picked up within the cutoff times to the scheduled network runs in the shift. Ensure Performance Driven Culture. Adherence to Performance Management system timelines and guidelines.

The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity. Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. Key Roles & Responsibilities. Hub Operations Management. Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement. Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements. Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower. Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives. Mid Mile Network Operations. Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network. Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity. Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy. Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times. Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment. Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations. Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub. Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations. Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication. Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans. Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations. Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance. Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub. People Leadership & Capability Development. Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives. Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations. Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance. Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes. Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub. Qualifications & Experience. Education. Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage. Experience. Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations. Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network. Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management. Service Quality & Operational Excellence . Operational MIS & Performance Analytics . Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance . Process Improvement & Productivity Enhancement . Team Leadership & People Development . Cross-Functional Collaboration . Customer Focus . Accountability & Ownership . Adaptability & Resilience . Continuous Improvement Mindset . The Operations Executive / Senior Operations Executive – eCommerce Operations is responsible for managing the day-to-day operational execution of the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the surface network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations for the eCommerce product, ensuring shipment visibility, network connectivity, service quality and adherence to committed timelines. Reporting to the Hub Manager, the incumbent works closely with Linehaul Operations, Network Operations, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient hub processing, timely dispatches and effective resolution of operational exceptions. The role plays a critical part in maintaining service reliability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction for the eCommerce product across the surface logistics network. Job Purpose. To manage end-to-end hub operations for the eCommerce product by ensuring timely processing, consolidation and movement of shipments across the surface network, while maintaining operational accuracy, service quality, network connectivity and compliance with organisational standards. Key Roles & Responsibilities. eCommerce Product Operations. Manage day-to-day operational activities for the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub. Ensure timely receipt, segregation, processing, consolidation and dispatch of eCommerce shipments. Monitor shipment flow across inbound, outbound and transit operations to achieve network timelines. Ensure adherence to operational workflows, product handling standards and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Support achievement of product-specific service quality and operational performance targets. Surface Network Coordination. Coordinate movement of eCommerce shipments through scheduled surface linehaul and feeder network operations. Ensure timely loading, dispatch and connectivity of shipments to destination hubs and service centres. Monitor adherence to network cut-off timings and dispatch schedules. Coordinate with Network Operations and Linehaul teams to minimise delays and optimise shipment movement. Ensure accurate shipment visibility through timely scanning and system updates. Shipment Processing & Exception Management. Monitor scanning, sorting, bagging and dispatch activities to ensure operational accuracy. Proactively identify and resolve shipment exceptions including delays, misroutes, scanning discrepancies and stock lying at hub (SLAH). Coordinate with originating and destination locations to ensure timely closure of operational exceptions. Ensure prompt communication of network disruptions and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders. Drive timely resolution of service issues impacting product performance. Operational Coordination & Service Performance. Coordinate daily with Hub Operations, Linehaul, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless operational execution. Monitor daily shipment volumes and support manpower planning based on operational requirements. Track product-specific operational performance and recommend corrective actions to improve service reliability. Support implementation of process improvements and operational best practices across the hub. Prepare operational updates and escalate critical service issues to the Hub Manager in a timely manner. Service Quality & Operational Excellence. Monitor operational performance against defined service level agreements (SLAs) and eCommerce product commitments. Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions to minimise service failures and improve shipment visibility. Monitor shipment ageing, pending loads and stock lying at hub (SLAH), ensuring timely corrective actions. Drive adherence to scanning compliance, shipment accuracy and operational quality standards. Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance service reliability and operational productivity. Resource Planning & Hub Coordination. Coordinate with the Hub Manager to ensure adequate manpower, equipment and operational resources are available to support daily volumes. Support daily operational planning based on shipment forecasts, network priorities and hub capacity. Coordinate with transport partners and linehaul teams to ensure timely vehicle placement and dispatch readiness. Ensure optimum utilisation of operational resources to achieve productivity and cost efficiency. Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and volume surges. Compliance & Operational Governance. Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs and statutory requirements applicable to hub operations. Promote safe handling of shipments and adherence to security protocols across all operational activities. Support internal audits, quality reviews and compliance assessments, ensuring timely closure of observations. Maintain operational records, documentation and system updates in accordance with organisational requirements. Escalate operational risks, compliance gaps and service issues to the Hub Manager on a timely basis. Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement. Generate and maintain daily operational MIS and product performance reports. Monitor key operational metrics and analyse trends to identify opportunities for process improvement. Support implementation of automation initiatives and standardised operational practices across the hub. Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving network efficiency and customer experience. Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability and continuous improvement within the product operations team. Qualifications & Experience. Education. Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Certification or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Operations Management will be an added advantage. Experience. 3–5 years of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, eCommerce logistics or hub operations. Experience in managing hub operations, shipment processing or mid-mile logistics within a high-volume environment. Exposure to surface linehaul operations, shipment tracking and operational performance management. Experience in coordinating with multiple internal stakeholders to achieve network and service commitments. Working knowledge of logistics management systems, operational dashboards and Microsoft Office applications. Skills & Capabilities. Technical Skills. eCommerce Hub Operations Management . Surface Network & Linehaul Coordination . Shipment Processing & Transit Operations . Scanning, Bagging & Dispatch Management . Service Level Agreement (SLA) Management . Operational MIS & Performance Reporting . Exception Management & Service Recovery . Process Improvement & Operational Excellence . Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance . Microsoft Office & Logistics Management Systems . Behavioural Competencies. Customer Focus . Planning & Organising . Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills . Attention to Detail . Decision Making . Collaboration & Stakeholder Management . Accountability & Ownership . Adaptability & Resilience . Communication Skills . Continuous Improvement Mindset . Key Performance Indicators. Sr. No. Key Result Areas. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). 1. Service Performance. Timely processing and dispatch of eCommerce shipments; Network cut-off adherence; Shipment connectivity. 2. Shipment Quality. Scan compliance; Shipment processing accuracy; Reduction in misroutes, misconnections and operational errors. 3. Operational Efficiency. SLAH reduction; Shipment ageing; Hub productivity; Turnaround time (TAT) adherence. 4. Network Coordination. Linehaul schedule adherence; Vehicle dispatch readiness; Timely communication of operational exceptions. 5. Customer Experience. Timely closure of product exceptions; Service recovery within TAT; Product SLA adherence. 6. Compliance & Governance. SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety and security compliance. 7.
